resources.string: Tap to add a spark in a floating sheet over any app.
Store Sparks adds a quick-add sheet to your phone. Add the widget from the home-screen widget picker, add the \"Add spark\" tile in Quick Settings, and turn on the accessibility button below.
Adds a floating accessibility button that opens the Store app\'s quick spark-capture sheet. Reads no screen content — it only listens for the button being tapped.
